query: SELECT npc_round_source.message_id FROM npc_round_source JOIN history_entry ON history_entry.id = npc_round_source.message_id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.branch_id = history_entry.branch_id JOIN npc_agent ON npc_agent.agent_id = agent_history.agent_id WHERE npc_round_source.round_id = ?1 AND (?2 IS NULL OR npc_agent.character_id = ?2)
